title: Typing
summary: Every word written from its meaning.
description: For words that are known but need recalling, not just recognising.

requirements.text: A typing lesson asks every word by typing it from its meaning, whatever the word's history; where its level does not allow typing, by picking the word.

history.text: A typing lesson asks every word by typing it from its meaning, whatever the word's history.
history.reason: Typing is beyond A1, so an A1 typing lesson asks the hardest card A1 allows instead.

requirements.text: A new word in a typing lesson is shown on a card before it is typed.
